{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Right decision'' I made, evacuating the last of the population. ''Overrun'' by ''Separatist'' troops, this moon is.|Yoda|<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
This '''unidentified moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that served as a colony for a [[Human/Legends|Human]] population. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], knowing that this colony couldn't be saved from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion, most of the population evacuated the moon. [[Standard month/Legends|Months]] later, in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went on a [[Mission to unidentified besieged moon|mission]] to the besieged moon in order to evacuate the last of its population.
